title: Attagasam
desc: Jeeva and Guru are twins who get separated in childhood by their mother in order to save their lives. When they reunite several years later, Guru swaps places with Jeeva.

title: Ponniyin Selvan
desc: On the orders of crown prince and his friend Aditha Karikalan, Vallavaraiyan Vandiyadevan embarks on a mission to deliver a message where he discovers several conspiracies against the throne.

title: Nadigan
desc: Desperate for money, a man poses as an elderly tutor for two young women. Later, he catches feelings for one of them while also wooing their guardian at the same time.

title: Kasthuri Maan
desc: Arun, a district collector, promises to marry Uma who helped him pass his IAS exams. Things take a bad turn when Uma ends up in jail, unsure about her future and their relationship.

title: Pudhu Pettai
desc: A young boy runs away when his mother dies and ends up in the company of a gangster. He soon becomes the right-hand man of his employer and makes dangerous enemies.
